annotations.title: Find companies hiring for given roles

description: Buying-intent signal: which companies are hiring for the roles you care about, how many roles, how fresh, and seniority/locations. Give target accounts (their jobs-page URLs on Greenhouse, Lever, Ashby, Workday, SmartRecruiters, Recruitee, Personio, Teamtailor) and/or job-search phrases to discover companies. Runs the Apify Actor tacps126/hiring-signals on your Apify account (about $0.01 per company with a matching signal; companies without one are free; spend per call is capped at $0.5).

extra_input.description: Advanced: extra Actor input fields, merged over the defaults.

max_items.description: Maximum results to return (default 50, max 500). Cost scales with this.

posted_within_days.description: Only roles posted in the last N days.

role_keywords.description: A role counts when its title contains any of these words, e.g. ["data engineer","security"]. Empty = every role.

searches.description: Job-search phrases to discover companies you do not know yet, e.g. "head of security".

name: find_hiring_companies

count.description: Number of records the Actor returned.

items.description: The records. Long text fields are shortened to 600 characters.

shown.description: Number of records included in `items` (can be lower than count when the result is long).

tool.description: Name of the tool that produced the result.

truncated.description: True when records were left out to keep the result short; ask for fewer items.

title: Find companies hiring for given roles
